default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1448.title: Bald bar after a leg
E-1448.hypothesis: A bar that opens on its extreme and closes away from it right after a leg the other way shows one-sided aggression with no counter-trading at the open; trade against the leg.

E-1449.title: Previous-block false break fade
E-1449.hypothesis: Poking beyond the prior 15/30/60-minute block's high or low and closing back inside it traps stop orders placed at the block edge; fade back into the block.

E-1450.title: Recovery through the mid of the rolling range
E-1450.hypothesis: After price sat at the bottom (top) of its rolling range, a close through the middle means the extreme was absorbed and the other side took control; follow it.

E-1451.title: New-extreme push count follow
E-1451.hypothesis: Several separate bars each making a new session high (low) in a short window show repeated, successful aggression by one side; follow when a push bar closes with the move.

E-1452.title: Micro-poke in a VWAP trend
E-1452.hypothesis: When price has stayed on one side of VWAP, a bar that pokes through the prior bar's extreme and closes back is a shallow pullback absorbed by the trend side; trade with the trend.

E-1454.title: Midday momentum flip
E-1454.hypothesis: In the thin 11:30-14:30 window a move that grows larger than usual for the horizon is driven by few large orders that keep working; follow its onset.

E-1455.title: Volume above the session midpoint
E-1455.hypothesis: When most of the session's volume has traded above (below) the running range midpoint, the market accepts higher (lower) prices; follow the crossing of that share.

E-1456.title: Prior-bar open reclaim pair
E-1456.hypothesis: A bar that closes beyond the open of a large opposite bar reverses it fully; with or against the 60-minute EMA side this marks who is trapped.

E-1457.title: Flush bounce through the prior bar
E-1457.hypothesis: A fast multi-bar flush larger than usual triggers stops; the first bar to close beyond the previous bar's extreme the other way shows forced sellers (buyers) are done.
